profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Passionate software engineer with a background in cyber security, software design, and internal tools and infrastructure. Adapts well to emerging trends and technologies. Experienced in delivering products and quick-reaction capabilities to customers. 

Proficient in a variety of programming languages, primarily C, C++, Java, and Python, each of which are used daily. Developed small personal projects in several other languages, including JavaScript, Rust, Kotlin, and PHP. Always attempting to keep up with the latest trends in language features, design paradigms, software libraries, etc..

Diverse skill set includes reverse engineering (of malware and proprietary vendor software), x86/x86_64 assembly language and architecture, Linux operating system internals, and debugging of complex, proprietary production systems. In-depth knowledge of the Executable and Linker Format (ELF) binary structure, and using advanced features of compilers and linkers to deliver optimized, production-ready software.

Taken projects from whitepapers through productization, which included requirements gathering and the complete software development lifecycle. Experience working closely with customers using agile methodologies to develop deployable solutions.

Possesses excellent written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated through presentations at large, multi-agency conferences (Blackhat-style), dissemination of technical reports, technical and non-technical documentation and whitepapers.

Specialties: cyber security, CNO tool development, malware analysis, backend web development, internal tools, software engineering and design patterns.

Learned effective communication techniques, valuable leadership skills, and immense patience.

volunteerExperiences.role: Student Volunteer on the Parks and Recreations Board
volunteerExperiences.description: In High School, as a member of the Future Business Leaders of America (FBLA), I volunteered to sit as a student member on the City of Keizer's Parks and Recreations Board. In this role, I attended biweekly board meetings to discuss park matters, and provided input from a student's perspective on many issues surrounding the local parks.

In High School, as a member of the Future Business Leaders of America (FBLA), I volunteered to sit as a student member on the City of Keizer's City Council. In this role, I attended the monthly City Council meetings as a student volunteer on the board. In this role, I acted as a student Liason to the board, representing Keizer's own McNary High School and disseminating relevant information about the school to the Keizer and its citizens.
